battle.name: 蘇德戰爭
battle.theater: 斯摩稜斯克至基輔前線
battle.brief: 1941年6月22日德軍發動巴巴羅薩行動，蘇德戰爭在歐洲東線全面展開，至1945年5月德軍在柏林投降，歷時近四年。卡面T-34/76坦克1940年定型、1941年夏配屬新建坦克旅，首次成建制投入斯摩稜斯克與基輔方向的消耗戰，隨後撐過莫斯科、史達林格勒與庫爾斯克三場戰役。

kit.name: T-34/76坦克
kit.history: 1939年列裝蘇聯紅軍，1941年廣泛配屬於東歐機械化師團。

countries: 蘇德戰爭是第二次世界大戰的歐洲主戰場，自1941年6月22日至1945年5月8日進行，交戰主體是蘇聯紅軍與納粹德國國防軍。蘇聯方面由人民委員會與國防委員會統轄：6月30日成立國防委員會，史達林任主席兼總司令，總參謀長初為沙波什尼科夫，1942年改由華西列夫斯基接任；作戰指揮分屬西北、西南、南部三個方面軍，其後擴為沃羅涅日、北方、草原等戰役集團，1941年夏紅軍在西線保有約一百九十四個步兵師、五個騎兵軍、三個坦克軍與三個機械化軍，內陸方面軍的後備部隊則隨時向前方調撥。德國方面最高決策在希特勒，經國防軍最高統帥部與陸軍總司令部執行；巴巴羅薩行動分北、中、南三路指向明斯克、斯摩稜斯克與基輔，中央集團軍群由勃克指揮，南方集團軍群先後由倫德斯泰特、賴歇瑙、曼施泰因接掌，裝甲兵則集中在古德里安的第2裝甲師、霍特的第3裝甲師與菲廷科的第11裝甲師。軸心盟軍中，義大利由墨索里尼調派遠征軍在1941年6月22日同時開火；羅馬尼亞安東內斯庫同年6月投入三個集團軍，攻取克里米亞與比薩拉比亞；芬蘭曼納海姆續行冬季戰爭並向卡累利阿推進；保加利亞與斯洛伐克於1941年3月先行參戰，匈牙利於1942年1月加入，克羅地亞烏斯塔沙另組部隊參戰，西班牙與維希法國也派出志願兵。除正規軍外，英美以租借法案供給燃料、卡車與航空汽油，並以英軍部隊自北非與諾曼第兩個方向牽制德軍，使德軍無法自西線調兵東援，蘇聯因此得以在東線獨力承受最初數月的全部壓力。
countriesEn: The Soviet-German War was the main European theatre of the Second World War, fought from 22 June 1941 to 8 May 1945, between the Red Army of the Soviet Union and the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany. On the Soviet side the war was directed by the Council of People's Commissars and the State Defence Committee: the committee was created on 30 June, with Stalin as its chairman and commander-in-chief; the chief of the general staff was Sapozhnikov at first, replaced in 1942 by Vasilevsky. Operational command was divided among the North-Western, South-Western and Southern fronts, later expanded into the Voronezh, Northern, Steppe and other operational groupings. In the summer of 1941 the Red Army held on the western front about 194 rifle divisions, five cavalry corps, three tank corps and three mechanised corps, with the reserves of the Interior Military District pushed forward continuously. On the German side the highest decisions rested with Hitler, executed through the Wehrmacht High Command and the Army General Office. Operation Barbarossa was launched on three axes toward Minsk, Smolensk and Kiev: Army Group Centre was under Bock, while Army Group South passed in turn to Rundstedt, Reichenau and Manstein, and the armoured mass was concentrated in Guderian's 2nd Panzer Division, Hoth's 3rd Panzer Division and Fedorenko's 11th Panzer Division. Among the Axis satellites, Mussolini sent Italian expeditionary troops into the same fighting on 22 June 1941; Antonescu committed three Romanian army groups in June of the same year to take Crimea and Bessarabia; Mannerheim in Finland continued the Winter War and pushed into Karelia; Bulgaria and Slovakia entered the war in March 1941, Hungary in January 1942, the Croatian Ustaše formed its own units, and Spain and Vichy France sent volunteers. Alongside the regular armies, Britain and the United States supplied fuel, trucks and aviation gasoline under the Lend-Lease Act and tied down German forces with British troops from North Africa and from Normandy, so that Germany could not shift troops from the west; the Soviet Union was thus left to bear the entire opening pressure of the Eastern Front alone.
people: 史達林是這場戰爭不可分割的核心。1941年7月3日他在廣播講話中把當前戰局稱為「祖國保衛戰」，30日出任國防委員會主席，把工業、財政與徵兵全部置於自己領導之下，親自批准把莫斯科城下的學校、劇院與工廠機器轉造炮彈、坦克與飛機。朱可夫自1941年9月30日起任西方面軍司令，主持莫斯科保衛戰，12月5日發動反擊把德軍逐回奧廖爾與克林一線，其後接掌最高統帥權；華西列夫斯基1942年出任參謀總長，1943年策劃庫爾斯克方向的縱深反擊。集團軍與方面軍層面，鐵木辛哥在8月組織雅爾采沃反擊，沃伊科夫死守列寧格勒方向，19軍司令科涅夫自加告夫突出重圍，帕夫洛夫的第3軍與第16軍在斯摩稜斯克一線被打崩，北方集團軍與加里波利波的第21集團軍在奧廖爾方向迎擊德軍第2裝甲集群。德方人物同樣密集：希特勒策劃巴巴羅薩並直接過問戰役節奏，凱特爾主持國防軍最高統帥部，哈德任陸軍總司令兼參謀長，勃克指揮中央集團軍群，古德里安以第2裝甲師撕開明斯克缺口，曼施泰因以第57師配合第3、第11裝甲師完成「逆向打擊」引導集團軍群突破，賴歇瑙在烏曼地區合圍蘇軍第5、第6、第12、第19軍。史達林格勒方面，第六集團軍司令保羅斯在1942年8月被解除指揮、由施圖特接任，1942年12月曼施泰因發動「冬季風暴」解圍，最終仍告失敗。戰爭末段，柏林的布魯內納、魏克斯與維恩納主持最後防禦，直到5月8日在卡爾斯霍斯特簽署投降書。
peopleEn: Stalin is inseparable from this war. On 3 July 1941, in a radio address, he called the present struggle a Patriotic War; on the 30th he became chairman of the State Defence Committee, placing industry, finance and conscription under his own direction, and personally approving the conversion of the machinery of Moscow's schools, theatres and factories into shells, tanks and aircraft. Zhukov took command of the Western Front on 30 September 1941 and directed the defence of Moscow, launching the counter-offensive on 5 December that drove the Germans back toward Oryol and Klin, and he later took overall command; Vasilevsky became chief of the general staff in 1942 and planned the deep counter-offensive at Kursk in 1943. At army and front level, Timoshenko organised the Yartsevo counter-offensive in August, Voikov held the Leningrad direction, the commander of the 19th Army, Konev, broke out of encirclement at Sukomaki, Pavlov's 3rd and 16th Armies were shattered around Smolensk, and the Northern Group and Garlikov's 21st Army met the German 2nd Panzer Cluster at Oryol. The German side is equally crowded: Hitler planned Barbarossa and supervised its tempo personally, Keitel chaired the Wehrmacht High Command, Halder was the army chief of staff, Bock commanded Army Group Centre, Guderian tore open the Minsk gap with the 2nd Panzer Division, Manstein's 57th Infantry Division working with the 3rd and 11th Panzer Divisions produced the counter-thrust that guided Army Group South through the encirclement, and Reichenau closed the trap that swallowed the Soviet 5th, 6th, 12th and 19th Armies at Uman. In the Stalingrad sector, the 6th Army commander Paulus was relieved in August 1942 and replaced by Stuhle; in December 1942 Manstein launched Winter Storm to relieve the pocket, and it failed. At the end of the war, Bruchener, Wechsler and Wiene defended Berlin until the surrender was signed at Karlshorst on 8 May.
kits: 卡面上的T-34/76坦克是這場戰爭裝備史的主線。它由科什金主持設計，1939年12月定型，1940年1月造出首批原型車，1940年6月完成圖紙、9月首批量產下線；1941年6月巴巴羅薩開打時，裝甲部隊仍在消化1939年那一小批車，真正成建制投入作戰是在同年夏末，7月中下旬第一突擊集團軍在奧西波維奇方向、8月雅爾采沃反擊與9月莫札伊斯克防線上的戰鬥中，都可以看到它的身影。車體採大角度斜側裝甲，傾斜面可達六十度，炮塔為五人大開門式，裝F-34 76.2毫米火砲，1942年初仍難以取得穿甲榴彈；底盤用克里斯蒂扭桿懸掛與大直徑主動輪，V-2-34 500匹馬力柴油機，公路時速約三十二公里，最大行程約三百至四百公里，越野時速僅十公里上下。無線電與瞄準具的落後，使它難以與步兵、空軍協同，履帶與傳動的機械性故障也造成大量非戰損。哈爾科夫與史達林格勒的工廠在戰事爆發後被迫西遷，生產改由烏拉爾與伏爾加的廠區接續：1941年型火砲零件多達八百六十一件，1942年型簡化至六百一十四件，單車成本由二十六萬盧布降至十九萬三千盧布，這正是以簡化換產量的典型。同期德軍主力為三號與四號戰車，其上裝的是37與75毫米砲，對上T-34/76時火力吃虧，於是加快Panther的研製，並以88毫米高射砲改裝成反戰車砲；蘇軍同樣大量使用同一門火砲的衍生型，包括1942年出現的SU-76自走砲以及SU-85、SU-100驅逐砲。1944年2月起換上三人炮塔與85毫米砲的T-34/85出現，砲口初速每秒七百九十七米，二百米內可擊穿虎式與豹式的正面裝甲，才真正在火力上追平德軍。步兵方面雙方仍大量使用莫辛-那甘步槍、PPSh-41衝鋒槍與PTRD-1941穿甲手槍，砲兵有76毫米師屬砲、122毫米與152毫米榴彈砲，火箭砲BM-13則在1941年秋首次投入批量射擊。
kitsEn: The T-34/76 on the card face is the main thread running through the equipment history of this war. It was designed under Koshkin, was finalised in December 1939, produced its first prototypes in January 1940, had its drawings completed in June 1940 and rolled off the production line in September of that year. When Barbarossa opened in June 1941 the armoured forces were still working through the small batch built in 1939; the type really entered combat in formation during the late summer of the same year, and it can be seen in the fighting of the 1st Shock Army in the Osipovichi direction in mid and late July, in the Yartsevo counter-offensive of August, and on the Mozhaisk defensive line in September. The hull uses heavily sloped armour with plates inclined to about sixty degrees, the turret is a five-man open-topped design, and the armament is the F-34 76.2mm gun, for which high-explosive anti-tank shells were still hard to obtain in early 1942. The running gear uses Christie torsion-bar suspension with large road wheels and a 500 horsepower V-2-34 diesel, giving about thirty-two kilometres per hour on road and a maximum range of roughly three to four hundred kilometres, against only some ten kilometres per hour cross-country. The lack of radios and of good sights made coordination with infantry and air force difficult, while mechanical failures in the tracks and transmission created heavy non-battle losses. The Kharkov and Stalingrad works were forced to move east after the war began, with production continued at plants in the Urals and on the Volga: the 1941 gun had as many as eight hundred and sixty-one parts, the 1942 model was simplified to six hundred and fourteen, and unit cost fell from two hundred and sixty thousand roubles to one hundred and ninety-three thousand, a classic case of trading refinement for output. Germany's principal tanks at the time were the Panzer III and Panzer IV, armed with 37mm and 75mm guns and out-gunned by the T-34/76; this hurried the development of the Panther and led to 88mm anti-aircraft guns being converted into anti-tank weapons. The Soviet Union used the same gun in large numbers of derivatives, including the SU-76 self-propelled gun that appeared in 1942 and the SU-85 and SU-100 tank destroyers. From February 1944 the three-man turret and 85mm gun of the T-34/85 appeared, its muzzle velocity of seven hundred and ninety-seven metres per second allowing it to penetrate the frontal armour of Tigers and Panthers at two hundred metres, and only then did the family truly match German firepower. On the infantry side both armies still used the Mosin-Nagant rifle, the PPSh-41 submachine gun and the PTRD-1941 anti-tank rifle in bulk, the artillery included 76mm divisional guns and 122mm and 152mm howitzers, and the multiple rocket launcher BM-13 went into massed use for the first time in the autumn of 1941.
tactics: 巴巴羅薩的戰術核心是寬正面突破加縱深推進：北方集團軍群沿波羅的海沿岸直取列寧格勒，中央集團軍群在明斯克合圍後直趨斯摩稜斯克，南方集團軍群則由布列斯特打到基輔，三路裝甲兵平均每日推進數十公里，摩托化步兵師跟進佔領，Ju 87俯衝轟炸機為裝甲兵開路；蘇軍縱深梯次部隊被鑽空分割，7月初奧波奇卡的機械化軍、8月斯摩稜斯克周邊的戰車兵相繼被合圍，巴巴羅薩頭六個月的蘇軍作戰幾乎完全失效。蘇軍的轉折是以縱深反擊對抗寬正面突進：在斯摩稜斯克方向以第16、第19軍於7月底至8月組織雅爾采沃反擊，9月再以第5、第16、第19軍在莫札伊斯克、沃赫拉兩道防線上投入新銳戰車旅，反擊德軍第2、第11裝甲師的突進，T-34/76正是在這一階段第一次以營團規模連續作戰；秋季起紅軍改守為主，構築反坦克壕、反坦克障礙與觀察哨網，把T-34/76當作機動支點插入德軍縱深，打擊其運輸隊與指揮所，莫斯科反擊中第5、第8、第10、第19軍與第2衝鋒集團軍即以戰車旅為先鋒，連續奪回克林、格扎茨克等地區。1942年史達林格勒與1943年庫爾斯克是相反的課目：前者是收縮防禦加縱深合圍，蘇軍以西南、頓涅茨、斯大林諸方面軍在11月19日同時自南北兩面收攏，把第六集團軍合圍；後者是蘇軍先以縱深反擊回應德軍「Citadel」攻勢，7月12日普羅霍羅夫卡的戰車交鋒是其中最著名的一幕。1944年巴格拉季昂行動與1945年維斯瓦-奧得河攻勢，蘇軍把突破、坦克大軍窮追與傘兵空降結合，前鋒日進數十公里；攻柏林的戰役則把華西列夫斯基的縱深戰役理論推到極致，三個方面軍自奧得河強渡後連續突破，逐層消耗德軍戰鬥群。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of Barbarossa was a wide-front breach followed by deep pursuit. Army Group North drove along the Baltic coast toward Leningrad, Army Group Centre closed around Minsk and ran for Smolensk, and Army Group South fought from Brest to Kiev; the three armoured thrusts advanced on average tens of kilometres a day, motorised infantry divisions followed to occupy the ground, and Ju 87 dive-bombers opened the way for the armour. Soviet formations held in depth were cut through and partitioned, and the mechanised corps at Opochka in early July and the tank troops around Smolensk in August were surrounded in turn, so that Soviet operations were almost completely ineffective during the first six months of Barbarossa. The Soviet answer was to counter the wide breach with deep counter-attacks: in the Smolensk direction the 16th and 19th Armies organised the Yartsevo counter-offensive from the end of July into August, and in September the 5th, 16th and 19th Armies threw fresh tank brigades into the Mozhaisk and Volkhov lines to check the thrusts of the German 2nd and 11th Panzer Divisions, and it was in this phase that the T-34/76 fought its first continuous operations at brigade and regimental scale. From autumn the Red Army turned to the defensive, digging anti-tank ditches, obstacles and a network of observation posts, and used the T-34/76 as a mobile pivot thrust into the German rear to strike at its supply columns and command posts; in the Moscow counter-offensive the 5th, 8th, 10th and 19th Armies and the 2nd Shock Army went in with tank brigades as spearheads and retook Klin, Rzhevsk and other towns in turn. Stalingrad in 1942 and Kursk in 1943 were the opposite lesson: the first was a contracting defence closed by deep encirclement, the Soviet South-Western, Don and Stalin fronts closing from north and south simultaneously on 19 November to trap the 6th Army; the second was the Soviet deep counter-offensive answering the German Operation Citadel, the famous clash of armour at Prokhorovka on 12 July being its best-known episode. In the Bagration operation of 1944 and the Vistula-Oder offensive of 1945, the Red Army combined the breach, the pursuit of the tank armies and airborne landings, the spearhead advancing tens of kilometres a day; the battle for Berlin carried Vasilevsky's theory of deep operations to its extreme, with three fronts breaking through successively after forcing the Oder and grinding down the German battle groups layer by layer.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾組。其一，巴巴羅薩行動的投入規模，一般估計德軍出動兵力逾三百八十萬人、汽車約六十萬輛、馬匹三百三十五萬匹、戰車與突擊砲近三千五百輛、火炮約二千七百門、飛機近一千九百架；蘇聯方面，1941年6月22日西部軍區常備兵員約三百餘萬，加上內陸後備與邊防部隊，總數在四百萬上下。戰爭歷時一般記載為1941年6月22日至1945年5月8日，前後一千三百八十九天。其二，損失：德軍在東線僅1941年的損失通常估計七十四萬至一百萬人，全東線的總損失一般認為逾三百萬人；蘇軍作戰陣亡逾八百萬，其中被俘者約五百七十萬、其中約二百八十萬人死於戰俘營，1941年一年紅軍損失的戰車與裝甲車約六千輛。其三，產量：T-34/76常見統計列出1940年約一千六百輛、1941年約六千五百輛、1942年約二萬四千七百輛，1943年起產量轉向換裝85毫米砲的T-34/85，至二戰結束T-34/76與T-34/85合計逾四萬輛，是二戰產量最大的坦克；蘇聯飛機年產量1941年約一萬五千架、1943年近三萬五千架，德國1941年約一萬一千餘架，雖在數量與質量上佔優，卻因東線消耗與飛行員損失而在1942年後逐步失勢。其四，幾場轉折戰役的時距與地理：史達林格勒自1942年8月23日打到1943年2月2日，「天王星」行動在11月19日完成合圍，圍內軸心軍約三十萬人；庫爾斯克戰役自1943年7月5日打到8月23日；巴格拉季昂行動自1944年6月22日打到8月19日，蘇軍在頭三天之內推進二百至三百公里。
dataEn: The verifiable figures fall into several groups. First, the scale of Operation Barbarossa: German forces committed are generally estimated at more than three million eight hundred thousand men, about six hundred thousand motor vehicles, three million three hundred and fifty thousand horses, close to three thousand five hundred tanks and assault guns, some two thousand seven hundred guns and nearly one thousand nine hundred aircraft. On the Soviet side the peacetime garrison of the western military districts on 22 June 1941 was around three million men, and with the interior reserves and border troops the total was on the order of four million. The duration of the war is generally given as 22 June 1941 to 8 May 1945, one thousand three hundred and eighty-nine days. Second, losses: German losses on the Eastern Front in 1941 alone are usually estimated at between seven hundred and forty thousand and one million men, and total German losses on that front are generally put above three million; Soviet military dead exceed eight million, of whom about five million seven hundred thousand were taken prisoner and of those some two million eight hundred thousand died in captivity, and in 1941 alone the Red Army lost about six thousand tanks and armoured vehicles. Third, production: the standard tables give the T-34/76 as about one thousand six hundred vehicles in 1940, about six thousand five hundred in 1941 and about twenty-four thousand seven hundred in 1942, with output turning in 1943 to the 85mm-armed T-34/85, and by the end of the war the T-34/76 and T-34/85 together exceeded forty thousand vehicles, making them the most produced tank of the war. Soviet aircraft output was around fifteen thousand in 1941 and nearly thirty-five thousand in 1943, while Germany produced a little over eleven thousand in 1941, ahead in both quantity and quality yet gradually losing ground after 1942 as the Eastern Front consumed its production and its pilots. Fourth, the timing and geography of the turning-point battles: Stalingrad ran from 23 August 1942 to 2 February 1943, with Operation Uranus closing the ring on 19 November around some three hundred thousand Axis troops; Kursk lasted from 5 July to 23 August 1943; and Operation Bagration ran from 22 June to 19 August 1944, the Soviet advance covering two to three hundred kilometres in its first three days.
cause: 巴巴羅薩不是臨時起意，而是德國三年準備的結果。1939年8月23日德蘇簽訂《蘇德互不侵犯條約》，德軍隨後取得波蘭西部，並藉芬蘭冬季戰爭鞏固北翼；1940年夏天，英國在法國崩潰後仍不屈不撓地由海上運兵，使希特勒的西進方案無法在歐洲大陸完成，向東取得生存空間的主張隨即成為替代方案。1941年春，巴巴羅薩計畫在入侵南斯拉夫之前完成，軸心國在巴爾幹與地中海的得手令德國相信蘇聯的戰時經濟已在1938年大清洗後被重創，紅軍指揮層與技術官僚大量遭到清除，邊防部隊在1941年夏仍按和平時期編制訓練；蘇聯則把大量德國戰俘、有德國血統的公民，以及在波蘭與波羅的海邊境上抓到的間諜一律槍決，使莫斯科相信戰爭已無法避免。直接導火索出現在1941年6月初：英國護航船隊在冰島海域擊沉德軍護航船拉普拉斯號，英軍佔領冰島、美軍進駐冰島與格陵蘭，希特勒相信英美下一步就會進攻蘇聯並截斷其進口戰略物資的航路，遂於6月22日下令開火。德方以消滅布爾什維主義和奪取生存空間為口號，把戰爭描述成文明的十字軍；蘇聯在毫無準備的狀態下被動應戰，同時指望英美在西線牽制德軍兵力，而這一指望在1941年秋即告落空，租借物資直到1941年10月才開始到位，前線的坦克與卡車缺口只能用產量填補。
causeEn: Barbarossa was not a sudden decision but the product of three years of preparation. On 23 August 1939 Germany and the Soviet Union signed the German-Soviet Non-Aggression Pact; the German army then took western Poland and strengthened its northern flank through the Winter War in Finland. In the summer of 1940, with France collapsed, Britain still shipping troops by sea and the western plan of Hitler unable to be completed on the European continent, the doctrine of securing living space in the east became the alternative. In the spring of 1941 the Barbarossa plan was completed before the invasion of Yugoslavia, and the Axis successes in the Balkans and the Mediterranean persuaded Germany that the Soviet war economy had been crippled by the purges of 1938, that the officer corps and technical bureaucracy of the Red Army had been largely removed, and that the border troops were still training on peacetime establishments in the summer of 1941. The Soviet Union, for its part, shot German prisoners of war, citizens of German blood and agents rounded up in Poland and on the Baltic frontier, and Moscow concluded that war could no longer be avoided. The immediate trigger came in early June 1941: a British convoy force sank the German escort vessel Lapland in Icelandic waters, Britain occupied Iceland and the United States based itself in Iceland and Greenland, and Hitler, believing that Britain and America would next attack the Soviet Union and cut the sea route for its strategic imports, gave the order to fire on 22 June. Germany fought with the slogans of destroying Bolshevism and seizing living space, presenting the war as a civilising crusade; the Soviet Union met the attack unprepared and passive, while counting on Britain and America to pin down German strength in the west, a hope that collapsed in the autumn of 1941, since Lend-Lease deliveries did not begin until October and the gaps in tanks and trucks on the front had to be filled by output alone.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是整個第二次世界大戰的走向與戰後數十年的國際格局。作戰層面上，德軍把陸軍主力與大部分摩托化裝備投入東線，蘇聯先後徵召逾三千四百萬人，四年間把部隊源源送上東線，使西線得以維持規模有限的第二戰場；盟國的戰略配售從1941年10月起源源不斷供給蘇聯卡車、鐵軌、航空汽油與糧食，西方盟國第一次不是靠自己的軍隊，而是靠一個大國的軍隊決定了歐洲戰場的成敗。政治層面上，蘇聯自1941年起主持歐洲反納粹聯盟的實際運作，戰後取得東歐與波羅的海的實控，1943年的德黑蘭會議、1944年的雅爾達會議與1945年的波茨坦會議把蘇聯的戰時貢獻轉化為東歐的勢力範圍，慕尼黑式的公開瓜分歐洲被歐洲內部的分區支配取代，冷戰的地理邊界在戰爭結束時已基本畫定。產業層面上，1941年夏德國的電廠與工廠向烏拉爾、伏爾加與西伯利亞遷移，蘇聯的戰時經濟由原本高度依賴歐洲的裝備輸入，轉為以國內重工業為核心，坦克、飛機、卡車與火炮的年產量在幾年內翻了幾番，戰後蘇聯陸軍因此擁有歐洲最大的地面部隊與裝備儲備，同時也帶來了高度集中的計劃經濟與軍工優先的資源分配。將軍層面上，德國的失敗被視為其總體戰體制與政策的徹底崩潰，東線的潰散直接導致1945年4月萊茵河右岸的全面失守；蘇聯則把衛國戰爭的經驗系統化，確立以大縱深戰役理論為核心的軍事學說，其中縱深作戰四字，正是T-34/76在1941年秋以小股戰車旅打擊德軍縱深、到1943年轉為以數十萬裝甲兵實施戰役縱深反擊的實踐總結。
impactEn: The outcome of this war shaped the course of the entire Second World War and the international order of the decades that followed. At the operational level Germany committed the bulk of its army and nearly all of its motorised equipment to the east, while the Soviet Union conscripted more than thirty-four million people and fed troops onto the Eastern Front for four years, which allowed the western theatre to be sustained at a limited scale; Lend-Lease shipments, beginning in October 1941, fed the Soviet Union with trucks, rails, aviation gasoline and grain without interruption, and the Western Allies discovered for the first time that it was not their own armies but those of a great power that would decide the European war. At the political level the Soviet Union ran the practical working of the anti-Nazi coalition from 1941 onward and after the war held actual control of Eastern Europe and the Baltic; the Tehran conference of 1943, the Yalta conference of 1944 and the Potsdam conference of 1945 converted Soviet wartime contribution into a sphere of influence in Eastern Europe, and the open division of Europe of the Munich kind was replaced by a partition ruled from within, with the geographic outline of the Cold War essentially drawn by the time the war ended. At the industrial level, in the summer of 1941 German power stations and works were transferred to the Urals, the Volga and Siberia, and the Soviet war economy, which had depended heavily on imported equipment from Europe, was rebuilt around domestic heavy industry; annual output of tanks, aircraft, trucks and guns multiplied within a few years, leaving the postwar Soviet army with the largest ground force and equipment reserve in Europe, but also with a highly centralised planned economy and a resource system that put munitions first. At the level of command, Germany's defeat was read as the total collapse of its system of total war, and the disintegration of the Eastern Front directly brought the loss of the right bank of the Rhine in April 1945; the Soviet Union systematised the experience of the Patriotic War into a military doctrine centred on deep operations, and the phrase deep operations is precisely the summary of the practice that began with T-34/76 brigades striking the German rear in the autumn of 1941 and ended with hundreds of thousands of armoured troops delivering deep counter-offensives in 1943.
result: 戰爭以蘇軍全面勝利告終，但過程分為幾個截然不同的階段。1941年夏秋，巴巴羅薩進展神速，基輔、明斯克、斯摩稜斯克相繼淪陷，蘇軍西撤數百公里，西部軍區的裝甲部隊與指揮體系幾乎被打散；轉折點出現在莫斯科，德軍在1941年12月初逼近城下三十公里處，紅軍於12月5日自三個方向反擊，至1942年1月初收復莫斯科，德軍中央集團軍群的冬季攻勢就此中止，此後再未恢復主動攻勢。1942年，蘇聯在史達林格勒把德軍第六集團軍合圍，保羅斯於1943年1月31日被俘，殘部在2月2日投降，曼施泰因的冬季風暴解圍失敗；1943年7月5日德軍以Citadel為名的攻勢在庫爾斯克被蘇軍的縱深反擊遏制，普羅霍羅夫卡一役德軍精銳裝甲師大量被毀，8月23日蘇軍收復哈爾科夫；1944年6月22日巴格拉季昂行動開始，中央集團軍群被殲，蘇軍解放波蘭並推進至維斯瓦河；1945年1月蘇軍自維斯瓦-奧得河發起攻勢，2月13日解放布達佩斯，4月16日發動柏林攻勢，5月2日蘇軍攻入德國國會大廈，5月8日德軍最高統帥部在柏林-卡爾斯霍斯特簽署投降書，歐洲戰事結束。T-34/76自1939年列裝到1945年退出前線走完了全程，它既是1941年救蘇聯的裝備，也是1945年攻入柏林的主要坦克之一，其逾四萬輛的累計產量與衍生的SU系列使它成為二戰產量最大、延壽最久的主戰坦克，並在戰後延續服務於二十餘國，冷戰時期的華沙條約國坦克部隊仍大量裝備它的改型。
resultEn: The war ended in complete Soviet victory, but the process fell into several very different stages. In the summer and autumn of 1941 Barbarossa advanced with astonishing speed: Kiev, Minsk and Smolensk fell in turn, the Soviet army withdrew several hundred kilometres, and the armoured formations and command structure of the western districts were almost shattered. The turning point came at Moscow, where German troops closed to within some thirty kilometres of the city in early December 1941; the Red Army counter-attacked from three directions on 5 December, retook the capital by the beginning of January 1942, and the winter offensive of Army Group Centre was checked for good, after which Germany never regained the initiative. In 1942 the Soviets closed around the German 6th Army at Stalingrad; Paulus was taken prisoner on 31 January 1943 and the remnants surrendered on 2 February, and Manstein's Winter Storm failed to relieve them. On 5 July 1943 the German offensive codenamed Citadel was halted at Kursk by the Soviet deep counter-offensive, at Prokhorovka the elite German panzer divisions were heavily mauled, and on 23 August the Soviets retook Kharkov. Operation Bagration opened on 22 June 1944, Army Group Centre was destroyed, the Red Army liberated Poland and advanced to the Vistula; in January 1945 the Soviet offensive from the Vistula-Oder began, Budapest fell on 13 February, the battle for Berlin opened on 16 April, Soviet troops stormed the Reichstag on 2 May, and the German High Command signed the surrender at Berlin-Karlshorst on 8 May, ending the war in Europe. The T-34/76 ran the whole course from service in 1939 to its retirement from the front line in 1945: it was the equipment that saved the Soviet Union in 1941 and one of the principal tanks that entered Berlin in 1945, and with a cumulative output of more than forty thousand vehicles and its SU derivatives it became the most produced and longest-lived main battle tank of the war, going on to serve more than twenty countries afterwards, with Warsaw Pact tank formations still fielding modified versions into the Cold War.
